Hello

this is polygon script for making Wavy Plane along Spline path.

required version: 3.5.x above. if you want to use ths with 2.6.1, please let me know. 

updated: current version is 20070428

I made this with Loft.js and Pathed Helix.js by Todd by reference. thank you so much for sharing those useful scripts.
